description: Test registration with valid details
expected: Account is created and the user is taken to the dashboard

description: Test login with a valid account
expected: Login succeeds and the dashboard is displayed

description: Test login with a wrong password
expected: Login is refused and the message "Invalid email or password" is shown

description: Test registration with a duplicate email
expected: Registration is refused with the message "Email already registered"

description: Test that required fields are validated
expected: Form is not submitted and both fields are marked as required

description: Check that the password is not stored in plain text (SR02)
expected: The stored value is a hash, the original password is not readable

description: Test adding a valid expense
expected: Expense is saved and appears at the top of the expense list

description: Test adding an expense with a negative amount
expected: Entry is refused with the message "Amount must be greater than zero"

description: Test adding an expense with a future date
expected: Entry is refused with the message "Date cannot be in the future"

description: Test editing an existing expense
expected: The updated amount is shown in the list and the totals change accordingly

description: Test deleting an expense
expected: Entry is removed from the list and no longer counted in the totals

description: Test adding an income record
expected: Income is saved and the available balance goes up by the same amount

description: Test the category suggestion (FR05)
expected: A category such as Travel is suggested, and the user can still change it

description: Test setting a monthly budget
expected: The budget is saved and shown on the dashboard for the current month

description: Test setting a zero or negative budget
expected: The value is refused with a message asking for an amount above zero

description: Test setting a category-wise budget
expected: The Food limit is saved and tracked separately from the monthly budget

description: Test the remaining budget calculation (FR08)
expected: Remaining budget shows 7500

description: Test the pie chart totals by category (FR10)
expected: Each slice matches the category total in the expense list

description: Test the monthly trend line chart
expected: A line chart is drawn with one point per month and correct monthly totals

description: Test that an unusual expense is flagged (FR11)
expected: The entry is flagged for review with a note asking the user to confirm the amount

description: Test that a normal expense is not flagged
expected: The entry is saved normally with no flag

description: Test the monthly expenditure forecast (FR12)
expected: A forecast is shown in a sensible range with the months it is based on

description: Test the forecast for a new account with no history
expected: No forecast is shown, instead a message saying more history is needed

description: Test creating a savings goal (FR14)
expected: The goal is created, appears in the goal list, and shows its progress (25% when ₹2,500 of ₹10,000 is saved) and the remaining amount

description: Test the time-to-goal estimate (FR15)
expected: An estimate in months is shown from the average monthly savings (₹15,000 remaining at ₹6,000 a month shows about 3 months)

description: Test the estimate when nothing is being saved
expected: No number is shown, instead a message that the goal cannot be reached at the current rate

description: Test creating a recurring expense (FR16)
expected: The recurring expense is saved and listed with its next due date

description: Test that a recurring expense is not created twice in one cycle
expected: Exactly one entry is created for the new cycle, not two

description: Test simulating an affordable purchase (FR19)
expected: The result shows the budget left after the purchase and marks it as affordable

description: Test simulating a purchase the user cannot afford
expected: The result warns that the purchase goes past the budget and shows the shortfall

description: Check that a simulation is not saved as a real expense
expected: No new expense appears in the list and the remaining budget is unchanged

description: Test exporting a report (FR20)
expected: A file downloads with figures matching the dashboard for that month

description: Test exporting a month with no data
expected: The app shows a message that there is nothing to export instead of an empty file

description: Test updating an existing savings goal
expected: The goal name and saved amount are updated, and progress and remaining amount are recalculated

description: Test deleting an existing savings goal
expected: The goal is deleted and no longer appears in the goal list

description: Test that users cannot modify another user savings goal
expected: Another user cannot update or delete the goal; the owner still has access to it

description: Test estimate when savings goal is achieved
expected: The goal shows 0 months remaining and a message that the goal has been reached

description: Test estimate recalculation after target amount changes
expected: The estimate is recalculated for the new target amount

description: Test estimate recalculation after savings rate changes
expected: The estimate is recalculated for the new average monthly savings

description: Test password recovery request and reset (FR01, SR09)
expected: A single-use reset link is issued and allows setting a new password, invalidating older sessions

description: Test account lockout after 5 consecutive failed logins (SR09)
expected: 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes, rejecting further attempts with 429

description: Stop login response time revealing which emails are registered (SR09, #72)
expected: Login response duration for existing and non-existing emails is indistinguishable

description: Test two-factor authentication setup with QR code (SR03, #104)
expected: A TOTP secret and QR code URI are generated for authenticator app enrollment

description: Test two-factor login verification and backup codes (SR03, #105, #106)
expected: Login requires 2FA code; single-use backup codes grant access and cannot be reused

description: Check requireAdmin enforcement on admin endpoints (SR01, #110, #111)
expected: Non-admin users receive 403 on all /api/admin routes; admins are granted access

description: Test recording and querying security events (SR09, #118)
expected: Failed logins and lockouts are logged and summarized in the security events API

description: Test append-only admin audit log recording (SR10, #123)
expected: Admin actions create immutable audit entries with no personal financial data

description: Test admin unlocking and logging out users (SR04, #114, #115)
expected: Admin can list users, unlock locked accounts, and invalidate sessions without seeing financial data

description: Test natural language money query engine (FR21, #96, #97)
expected: Question about monthly spending returns accurate total and category breakdown

description: Test receipt text parser extracting amount, date and shop (FR22, #83, #86)
expected: Receipt OCR text yields total amount, valid date, merchant name, and matched category

description: Check that the dashboard loads the logged-in user's own data
expected: Each user sees only their own totals, no data from the other account

description: Check that an idle session expires (SR07)
expected: The session ends and the user is sent back to the login page

description: Check that adding an expense updates the remaining budget
expected: Remaining budget drops from 8000 to 7500 without needing a page refresh

description: Check that a new expense shows up in the charts
expected: The Food slice grows and the chart total matches the expense list

description: Check that the warning alert fires at the threshold (FR09)
expected: A warning alert is shown saying the user is close to the budget limit

description: Check the alert when the budget is crossed
expected: An over-budget alert is shown and the remaining budget is displayed as -300

description: Check that only one alert is sent per threshold crossing
expected: No duplicate alerts are sent for the same threshold

description: Check the recommended budget stays within income (FR13)
expected: A category-wise suggestion is shown and the total does not exceed the income

description: Check the reminder before a due date (FR17)
expected: A reminder is shown for the upcoming payment

description: Check that reminders stop once the payment is marked paid
expected: The reminder no longer appears for that cycle

description: Check that unsafe input is rejected (SR05)
expected: The input is rejected or escaped, and nothing is executed when the entry is opened

description: Check that failed logins trigger security event and lockout (SR09, #118)
expected: Consecutive failed logins create a lockout and increment security event counts

description: Check that natural language query strictly isolates user data (#97)
expected: User A cannot query or see any totals or transactions belonging to User B

description: Check that a user cannot reach data pages without logging in (SR01)
expected: The app redirects to login and shows no financial data

description: Check a user cannot open another user's expense (SR04)
expected: The request is refused and no data from the other account is returned

description: Full budget cycle from setting a limit to being alerted
expected: Remaining budget updates each time and an over-budget alert appears on the last entry

description: Check that the health score reacts to a change in habits (FR18)
expected: The score drops and a short reason for the change is shown

description: Full user journey from registration to export
expected: Every step works in order and the exported figures match what the dashboard showed

description: Check that records survive a restart (NFR10)
expected: All entries are still present and the totals are unchanged

description: Full journey with password recovery and lockout clearance (UC-01)
expected: Locked account successfully requests reset link, resets password, and logs in with new password
